selected_problem: Fresh-main inspection and direct reproduction showed that ChangesetStore only validated each target path's file pre/post image. A nested target could be staged through an existing non-directory ancestor, or an ancestor could become a non-directory after staging. Apply and rollback preflight would still treat a missing nested target as compatible, then fail only during the later filesystem mutation after earlier files had already been changed. In-workspace symlink ancestors were also accepted, aliasing transactional path identity through another directory.

decision_provenance.mode_route_basis: The committed four-mode router's singular evidence-rich bottleneck gate selects DEEP_DEVELOPMENT because centrality and evidence density both exceed the gate thresholds; no mode rotation was forced.
decision_provenance.claim_limit: No hosted DWAC success receipt is claimed. The committed DWAC North Star scoring and four-mode routing source contracts were replayed against fresh canonical code evidence after the hosted Developer Execution Runtime returned a transient HTTP 502.

pre_fix_reproduction.stage_existing_nondirectory_ancestor: FAILED as expected: current main accepted dir/child.txt while dir was a regular file (Missing expected exception).
pre_fix_reproduction.apply_ancestor_drift: FAILED as expected: after staging with dir absent, creating dir as a regular file caused apply to throw EEXIST only after a preceding file had already been mutated.
pre_fix_reproduction.rollback_ancestor_drift: FAILED as expected: after apply deleted dir/child.txt, replacing dir with a regular file allowed rollback preflight to pass for the deleted target and fail only during restoration after an earlier rollback mutation.
pre_fix_reproduction.internal_symlink_ancestor: FAILED as expected: current main accepted alias/child.txt when alias was an in-workspace directory symlink.

changes: WorkspaceService now exposes ancestorState(rel), which inspects each existing ancestor component with lstat and distinguishes safe directories from symlink and non-directory ancestors without following in-workspace aliases.
ChangesetStore.stage rejects unsupported ancestors before persisting a changeset.
ChangesetStore.apply rechecks ancestor integrity for every path during the all-path preflight before the first mutation.
ChangesetStore.rollback rechecks ancestor integrity during rollback preflight before the first restoration.
Existing lexical boundary checks, external symlink-escape protection, final-target type rejection, canonical path identity, preimage/postimage checks and bounded changeset limits remain intact.
truth_boundaries: This closes the reproduced ancestor-type and in-workspace symlink-alias cases at stage/apply/rollback preflight. It does not claim inode-level detection of a directory replaced by another ordinary directory at the same lexical path between preflight and mutation.
Filesystem crash-level atomicity for arbitrary I/O/process failure remains unresolved.
Arbitrary complex repository semantic synthesis remains UNRESOLVED.
No new product form, feature roadmap, provider architecture or hard-coded task-to-mode mapping was introduced.
No GitHub Actions were intentionally triggered or rerun, no force push was used, and no credential, payment, formal Release or destructive/irreversible external action was performed.
